source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves universal filling, other tongues or languages, and Spirit-given utterance.
key_decisions.before: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking in other languages as the Spirit enabled them to speak.
key_decisions.after: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages as the Spirit enabled them to speak.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Jewish identity, devotion, comprehensive origins, and residence.
key_decisions.before: Devout Jewish people from every nation under heaven were living in Jerusalem.
key_decisions.after: Now devout Jewish people from every nation under heaven were living in Jerusalem.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout people from every nation under heaven.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps identities, proselytes, languages, and content of speech.
key_decisions.before: both Jews and converts to Judaism, Cretans and Arabs—we hear them speaking in our own languages about God’s mighty works.”
key_decisions.after: both Jewish people and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring God’s mighty works in our own languages!”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: both Jews and proselytes, Cretans and Arabians—we hear them telling in our own tongues the mighty works of God.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps divine speech, last days, all flesh, gendered children, generations, visions, and dreams.
key_decisions.before: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams.
key_decisions.after: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy; your young men will see visions, and your elders will dream dreams.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: ‘And in the last days it shall be, God declares, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams;

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves enslaved status, both genders, Spirit, and prophecy.
key_decisions.before: Even on my male and female servants I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
key_decisions.after: Even on my male slaves and female slaves I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: even on my servants, both men and women, in those days I will pour out my Spirit, and they shall prophesy.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps divine plan and foreknowledge alongside human agency, crucifixion, and death.
key_decisions.before: This man, handed over according to God’s determined purpose and foreknowledge, you killed by crucifying him through the hands of lawless people.
key_decisions.after: This man was handed over according to God’s determined plan and foreknowledge, and you killed him by having lawless people nail him to a cross.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: this Jesus, delivered up according to the definite plan and foreknowledge of God, you crucified and killed by the hands of those outside the law.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves contrast, resurrection, birth-pain image, impossibility, and death’s grip.
key_decisions.before: But God raised him up, freeing him from the pains of death, because it was impossible for death to hold him.
key_decisions.after: But God raised him up, releasing him from the pains of death, because it was impossible for death to hold him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But God raised him up, having loosed the pains of death, because it was not possible for him to be held by it.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps soul, Hades, Holy One, and bodily decay.
key_decisions.before: because you will not abandon my life to Hades or allow your Holy One to see decay.
key_decisions.after: because you will not abandon my soul to Hades or allow your Holy One to see decay.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you will not abandon my soul to Hades, or let your Holy One see corruption.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves prophetic identity, knowledge, oath, descendant, and throne.
key_decisions.before: Because he was a prophet and knew God had sworn an oath to him to place one of his descendants on his throne,
key_decisions.after: Because he was a prophet and knew that God had sworn an oath to him to seat one of his descendants on his throne,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Being therefore a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that he would set one of his descendants on his throne,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps foresight, Messiah, resurrection, Hades, flesh, and decay.
key_decisions.before: he foresaw and spoke about the resurrection of the Christ: he was not abandoned to Hades, and his flesh did not see decay.
key_decisions.after: he foresaw and spoke about the Messiah’s resurrection: he was not abandoned to Hades, and his flesh did not see decay.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: he foresaw and spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that he was not abandoned to Hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves conclusion, whole Israel, certainty, divine action, this Jesus, crucifixion, and titles.
key_decisions.before: Therefore let the whole house of Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ.”
key_decisions.after: Therefore, let the whole house of Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus—whom you crucified—both Lord and Messiah.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let all the house of Israel therefore know with certainty that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves commands, each person, name, Messiah, forgiveness, promise, gift, and Spirit.
key_decisions.before: Peter said to them, “Repent, and each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
key_decisions.after: Peter told them, “Repent, and each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus the Messiah for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, each of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps reception, baptism, approximate number, addition, and day.
key_decisions.before: So those who received his word were baptized, and about three thousand people were added that day.
key_decisions.after: So those who welcomed his word were baptized, and about three thousand people were added that day.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So those who received his word were baptized, and there were added that day about three thousand souls.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves persistence and all four communal practices.
key_decisions.before: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching, to fellowship, to the breaking of bread, and to the prayers.
key_decisions.after: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching, fellowship, the breaking of bread, and prayers.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves group, unity, and shared possessions.
key_decisions.before: All who trusted were together and held everything in common.
key_decisions.after: All the believers were together and held everything in common.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And all who believed were together and had all things in common.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps ongoing selling, distribution, universal reach, and need criterion.
key_decisions.before: They were selling possessions and property and distributing the proceeds to everyone according to need.
key_decisions.after: They sold property and possessions and distributed the proceeds to everyone according to each person’s need.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they were selling their possessions and belongings and distributing the proceeds to all, as any had need.
